veranderings.voor: 'n sorgsentrum vir mense met MIV in Johannesburg
veranderings.na: 'n sorgsentrum in Johannesburg vir mense met MIV
veranderings.rede: Placing 'in Johannesburg' after 'MIV' makes it read as if the virus is in Johannesburg; the place belongs with the centre.
An institution 'het gesluit' copies English 'closed'; 'het toegemaak' is the natural Afrikaans for a centre closing down.

veranderings.na: Sy eie ma is in 1997 oorlede
veranderings.rede: Right after Gail becomes his 'pleegma', a bare 'Sy ma' could be read as Gail; 'eie' makes clear it is his birth mother.

veranderings.voor: dat hy nie by hulle mag kom nie
veranderings.na: dat hy nie daar mag skoolgaan nie
veranderings.rede: 'hulle' does not agree with the singular 'die skool', and 'by hulle kom' is vague about what was refused.
'weggevat' is colloquial; 'weggeneem' is the standard written form for a right being taken away.
A story spreads ('versprei') through a country; 'geloop' is unidiomatic here.

veranderings.na: gesê die skool het reg opgetree
veranderings.rede: 'die skool is reg' says the school is correct rather than that its action was right; 'het reg opgetree' says what is meant.

veranderings.voor: Hy het in 1997 daar begin en
veranderings.na: Hy het in 1997 daar begin skoolgaan en
veranderings.rede: 'daar begin' has no complement and reads as unfinished; 'begin skoolgaan' completes the verb.

veranderings.voor: was daar 'n groot vergadering oor MIV en vigs in Durban
veranderings.na: was daar in Durban 'n groot vergadering oor MIV en vigs
veranderings.rede: With 'in Durban' at the end it attaches to 'vigs'; moving the place forward makes it belong to the meeting.

vlae.teks: Hy het gevra dat almal dieselfde behandel word.
vlae.rede: Slightly vague (equal treatment of whom, compared with whom), and 'behandel' returns later in its medical sense ('Vandag word MIV ook behandel'), so the 'ook' may read as an echo; not changed because sharpening it would mean guessing what Nkosi asked.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry says HOU 'VIGS' in capitals, but the lesson and the decided glossary headword and definition use lowercase 'vigs' (the AWS form). Nothing was changed; a person may want the entry and the lesson to agree on the case.
